independenceNote: Sole author Boris Kotov is a Robonine employee and declares a competing interest; Robonine sells the SO-ARM102 kit ($389) built on STS3215 and STS3250 servos.

source.title: Kotov, An open-source test stand for backlash measurement in low-cost UART servo motors (HardwareX, 2026, doi 10.1016/j.ohx.2026.e00767)

rig.torqueSensor: Two STS3215 puller servos loading through elastic bands
rig.encoder: The tested servo's own 12-bit encoder, read while it actively holds position

claims.source: Feetech datasheet <= 0.5 deg as quoted by Robonine; Feetech primary not verified

notes: Unloaded backlash 1.48 counts, about 0.13 deg; loaded backlash 3.78 counts, about 0.33 deg, at a 100 mm radius. The stored value is the unloaded figure. 1.48 counts is at the encoder's resolution (one count is about 0.088 deg). Play is read from the servo's own encoder while its position loop is active, so it includes the position-loop dead band and is not passive gear backlash.
